newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai authorities to address nation on baht move.
newsitem.headline: Thai authorities to address nation on baht move.

text.p: Thailand's Finance Minister Thanong Bidaya and central bank governor Rerngchai Marakanond will address the nation on Wednesday night to explain the government's decision to float the baht, officials said.
The address is scheduled to be broadcast live nationwide at 1330 GMT, officials told Reuters.
Financial authorities announced earlier the government would float the baht and said the value of the currency would be set by market forces instead of being pegged to a basket of currencies.
Analysts said the central bank's move to float the baht was a de facto devaluation.
